sentences.text: Protenodontosaurus was an extinct genus of placodont reptiles found in Italy, belonging to the parent group Placochelyida.
Currently, only a single fossil occurrence of Protenodontosaurus has been recorded in the Paleobiology Database.
The genus was named by Pinna in 1990, with Protenodontosaurus italicus serving as the type species — the species a genus is based on.
Fossils of this animal date to the Late Triassic, specifically the Carnian period between 237 and 233.6 million years ago.
